_notes: Does the assistant call Notify user when it hands the conversation back, and only then? (notify-user plan Part 3, docs/active/plans/2026-10-26-notify-user-red-and-model-driven.md in the workspace.) Capable sessions no longer get the app's automatic blue, so a missed call means the person never learns a reply is ready.

Five cases, one per situation in the plan's table: finished task (E1), needs a decision (E6), checkpoint mid-task (E2), quick answer (E4, should NOT notify), waiting on background work (E3, should NOT notify). All checks are mechanical; no rubric, so the judge is not called.
Models: the cloud spread plus Qwen 3.6 27B, the open-weight family a big local model runs. Three repeats each, because one run per arm measures noise (harness-evaluator rule).
